resources.string: Note that Bing search is crawler-based, which may be unstable and is not recommended.

Free keyless search router. Routes by intent across Open-Meteo, wttr.in, Google News, Qwant, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Wikimedia Commons, and Wikipedia (encyclopedia only), then merges titles, dates, snippets, and inline images.
